description: This file defines the AppTheme class for the Flutter application, centralizing styling constants and theme data for consistent UI across the app. It includes color schemes, text styles, component themes (buttons, input fields, app bars, cards, etc.), and utility functions for theme customization.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A class encapsulating the application's visual theme, including color palette, text styles, and component themes for consistent UI styling across Flutter screens.

methods.name: get lightTheme
methods.description: A static getter that constructs and returns the comprehensive ThemeData object configured for a light theme, utilizing the defined color scheme, text styles, and component themes.

methods.name: _onColor
methods.description: A utility method that determines the appropriate foreground color (white or text color) based on the brightness of the input background color.
